{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:10.419
    | text      = So Jordan, on Saturday, federal agents killed another citizen in Minneapolis.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:14.539
    | text      = The previous incident involved a person driving a car who'd been presumably blocking traffic
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:19.379
    | text      = before being confronted by agents.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:21.860
    | text      = It was an awful shooting, but the surrounding details of it allowed just enough wiggle room
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:25.899
    | text      = for state media surrogates like Alex to pretend that the agent was in fear for his life and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:30.740
    | text      = the killing was justified.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:32.980
    | text      = People whose careers rely on them pretending to be opposed to police brutality like Alex
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:37.059
    | text      = were able to continue their charade, taking up the position that the police shouldn't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:41.100
    | text      = kill people, but what do you expect when someone's driving a car at you?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:44.980
    | text      = It is what it is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:46.379
    | text      = Through their arguments, they were insincere and they were based in lies, but they were
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:50.740
    | text      = still able to keep that illusion going throughout this coverage of that shooting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:56.299
    | text      = But Saturday's shooting was entirely different.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:58.980
    | text      = I don't think it's a stretch the people online have called it an execution.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:02.519
    | text      = The victim was legally recording law enforcement, got assaulted by federal agents, then was
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:06.940
    | text      = taken to the ground and disarmed, after which point he was shot repeatedly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:11.600
    | text      = You can make out ten shots fired in the video of the murder and none of it can be justified.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:16.419
    | text      = The best argument someone can really make is that one of the officers misunderstood
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
